text:
Sofia Patel: Heads-up 1: candidate Priya Desai is flying in from LHR for onsite Fri 9:00am local. She arrives Thu evening and asked about a hotel recommendation and airport pickup. Can people-ops confirm what we cover and any travel stipend?

Noah Kim: I can cover the tech panel 9-11am. FYI Priya asked about borrowing a MacBook for the take-home micro task (shes Windows-only laptop).

people-ops: We usually offer one-night hotel (preferred hotels list) + airport taxi for international last-leg if arrival after 8pm. Travel stipend policy: up to $150 for ground transport + per diem for meals if needed. We can prepay taxi and book a hotel night. Which hotel do you prefer?

Sofia Patel: Midtown Inn (company rate) is ideal. Please block Thu night and return Fri late afternoon if interviews run long. Also confirm whether we can loan a MacBook (macOS dev image) for 4 hours Fri morning.

people-ops: Blocked Midtown Inn Thu night. Airport pickup booked (driver: BlueLine, pickup at Terminal 3, phone +1-555-0103). MacBook loaner reserved (ASSET LOAN-9982) at Reception from 8:30-13:00. Will include power adapter and external mouse.

Sofia Patel: Great. Can we also provide a local SIM or cash stipend if her phone plan won't work? She mentioned limited roaming.

people-ops: We can provide a preloaded SIM if requested. Ask candidate to confirm phone model. Otherwise we'll add $50 prepaid top-up to travel stipend.

Noah Kim: For the interview itself, Priya prefers CoderPad for the coding task and Miro for the system-design. Make sure CoderPad link is in the invite and Miro board is shared with her email.

people-ops: Noted. Recruiter will attach CoderPad link and Miro board. Also adding access instructions to the candidate packet with building entry, security badge pickup flow, and a QR code for the visitor kiosk.

Sofia Patel: One more logistics ask: Priya needs a visa support letter for the customs officer (she's on a transit visa). Can people-ops generate a letter for customs stating purpose of visit + dates?

people-ops: Yes, we can. Please DM the exact passport name and flight details and we'll issue a stamped letter. We'll also include a contact number for on-site support.

recruiter-bot: Calendar event created: "Priya Desai  Onsite: Eng Final" Fri 09:00-11:30 local. Hotel and pickup details attached. Candidate packet sent via email.

Sofia Patel: Thanks. Last point  expense submission: can travel receipts go to Ramp with code HIR-TRAVEL? people-ops or recruiter will pre-fill expense template?

people-ops: We'll email Priya a pre-filled expense template and the Ramp link. For any prepaid items we will flag them on the template so she only reports out-of-pocket expenses.

Noah Kim: All set on my end. If anything changes Fri morning Il ping the channel.

Sofia Patel: Appreciate it. Closing loop unless someone flags a problem. :white_check_mark:
